question: Explain why the electrostatic potential due to a system of charges at a point is obtained by algebraic addition, whereas electric field is obtained by vector addition. Give reason.

options.A: Both are scalar quantities and therefore are added algebraically
options.B: Both are vector quantities and therefore are added vectorially
options.C: Potential is a scalar, so potentials add algebraically; electric field is a vector, so field contributions add vectorially
options.D: Potential is vectorial because it can be positive or negative, whereas electric field is scalar
